## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 352 captures during July 2019. Activity was completed in line with the planned service arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 352 captures, 21 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 6.0. The result should be monitored through routine operational review, with attention to any recurring issues that may affect the quality of image capture. No further interpretation of the ungradable cases is included in this report.

## Grading

There were 52 referable results during July 2019. The median lag for grading was 1. This indicates that the midpoint grading wait was 1, based on the captures processed during the reporting period. Activity, image quality and grading results should continue to be reviewed together to support consistent service delivery at West Gate Eye Clinic.
